digest.component_or_area: Jira adapters (Cloud and Data Center reconciler)
propositions: Cloud and Data Center Jira adapters have asymmetric test coverage: Cloud has battle-tested byte-for-byte pins and ADF depth tests; Data Center has pagination and retry-handling proofs but lacks value-level characterization pinning.
The ticket-type map is duplicated within adapters/ and must be single-sourced before guards can prevent regression on both adapters.
Data Center adapter's create-path field values, sanitizer boundaries, identity label form, and all probe branches have never been pinned by value; only shape is asserted.
Data Center's comment and description length convergence and the comment ceiling provenance must be established and cited in source code.
Five enumerated tests in the suite are vacuous (assert shape only or have no contract enforcement) and must be either pinned to their intended contract or renamed.
